title: Ahrefs Pricing 2026: Plans, Limits, Add-Ons and Real Costs
summary: Ahrefs costs $129 (Lite), $249 (Standard), $449 (Advanced) or $1,499 (Enterprise) a month. Extra users, credit limits and add-ons explained.
body_markdown:
## The short answer


- **Lite $129 a month, Standard $249, Advanced $449, Enterprise $1,499** (Enterprise requires an annual commitment). Paying annually saves up to 17%.
- Each plan includes **one user** . Extra users cost $40 (Lite, up to 2 more), $60 (Standard, up to 5), $80 (Advanced, up to 10) or $100 (Enterprise) a month each.
- Lite caps usage at **1,000 credits per user a month** and 2,500 rows per report. Standard and above have unlimited credits.
- Add-ons cost extra: Content Kit from $99 a month, Report Builder $99, Brand Radar AI from $199, prompt packages $50 to $250, Project Boosts $20 or $200 per project.
- There is also a **$29 Starter** plan and a no-cost Ahrefs Free tier for verified site owners. Ahrefs says it never runs discounts.


Prices from ahrefs.com in October 2026.


Ahrefs pricing starts at $129 a month for Lite and runs to $1,499 a month for Enterprise. The plan price is the floor: users, usage limits and add-ons decide what a team actually pays.


Below is every plan and limit from Ahrefs' pricing page, what a realistic team bill looks like, and which plan fits whom.

Verified-ownership projects are unlimited on every plan. The project limits above apply to sites you track without verifying.


### What each tier adds


- **Lite:** Dashboard, Site Explorer, Keywords Explorer, Site Audit with always-on audits, Rank Tracker, competitive analysis, SERP history, Web Analytics, API and MCP access, Report Builder, and the Social Media Manager and GBP Monitor betas.
- **Standard** adds Portfolios, Content Explorer, Batch Analysis, SERP comparison, more Site Explorer reports (broken backlinks, broken links, outgoing links), keyword clusters, search intents and AI keyword suggestions.
- **Advanced** adds the Looker Studio integration, search type distribution, an agency directory listing and HTTP authentication in Site Audit.
- **Enterprise** adds uncapped API access, custom API endpoints, SSO, access management and audit logs, unlimited history and personalized higher limits.


## Starter and Ahrefs Free


Two entry options sit outside the main ladder.


**Starter, $29 a month.** Ahrefs describes it as a way to see what people search and research competitors. It is a lighter plan with tighter limits than Lite, aimed at people who need occasional lookups rather than ongoing SEO work.


**Ahrefs Free.** Free, limited access for website owners. It includes Site Explorer, Site Audit and Web Analytics for sites you verify, plus Social Media Manager, AI Content Helper and the SEO Toolbar. Ahrefs lists Site Audit at 5,000 crawl credits a month per project, Site Explorer showing 1,000 backlinks and keywords at once, and one AI Content Helper document a month.


Ahrefs Free works for auditing your own site. It does not let you research competitors' sites in depth, which is what most people pay for.

A prompt check is one prompt, on one AI platform, in one location. Tracking 50 prompts daily on two platforms is about 3,000 checks a month.


### Pay-as-you-go charges


Ahrefs' pricing FAQ states two automatic charges. Additional users not prepaid for are billed pay-as-you-go. And if you enable pay-as-you-go credits and data, you are charged automatically when usage exceeds your plan's limits. Those purchases (report credits, export rows, crawl credits, API units) last three billing months, and prepaid limits are used first.


## What a team actually pays


The sticker price is for one person. Worked examples at monthly billing:


Setup Calculation Monthly total


Solo founder, Lite $129 $129


Lite, 3 users (the maximum) $129 + 2 x $40 $209


Freelancer, Standard + Content Kit $249 + $99 $348


Marketing team of 4, Standard $249 + 3 x $60 $429


In-house team of 5, Advanced + Report Builder $449 + 4 x $80 + $99 $868


Enterprise, 3 users $1,499, annual commitment $1,499 ($17,988 a year)


Content Kit's price is listed as "from $99", so the higher tiers cost more. Annual billing cuts the main plan prices by up to 17%.


## Which Ahrefs plan fits whom


- **Starter:** you want to look up keywords and competitors occasionally and do not need projects, tracking or exports.
- **Lite:** one person running SEO for one business. The real constraint is 1,000 credits a month and 2,500 rows per report; heavy competitor research uses credits quickly.
- **Standard:** freelancers and consultants. Unlimited credits, 2 years of history, Content Explorer and Batch Analysis are the reasons to move up.
- **Advanced:** in-house teams with several people, larger sites (up to 250,000 pages per audit project) or Looker Studio reporting.
- **Enterprise:** organizations that need SSO, audit logs, uncapped API access or more than 11 users.


The Lite to Standard jump is the one most people end up making. If you will run more than a few deep competitor analyses a week, price Standard from the start.


## Refunds, cancellation and discounts


- **Discounts:** Ahrefs says it never runs discounts. Annual billing is the only saving.
- **Trial:** there is no paid-plan trial on the pricing page; Ahrefs Free is the way to try it.
- **Refunds:** Ahrefs does not issue refunds in general. On monthly plans you can request one if you have not used the service, and it may be declined if there is material activity.
- **Contracts:** no contracts or setup fees on self-serve plans. Upgrades apply immediately; downgrades and cancellations take effect at the end of the billing period, after which the account moves to Ahrefs Free.


## Alternatives to Ahrefs


Ahrefs is a research platform. It gives you data and tools; your team does the analysis and the work. Alternatives fall into two groups.


### Other SEO data platforms


Semrush is the closest like-for-like comparison. Our[Semrush pricing breakdown](https://www.sprites.ai/blog/semrush-pricing) covers its current plans and add-ons. For narrower needs, such as competitor keyword and ad research, see[SpyFu alternatives](https://www.sprites.ai/alternatives/spyfu) . If you need a large backlink index, rank tracking across thousands of keywords, or raw data exports for your own analysis, a data platform like Ahrefs is the better fit.


### An agent that does the SEO work


If what you are missing is time rather than data,[Sprites' AI SEO agent](https://www.sprites.ai/ai-seo) does the work itself. It runs keyword research with search volume checked against real search behavior, finds competitor keyword gaps, audits pages and sites, writes SEO blog posts and updates existing ones, and publishes to WordPress, Webflow, Shopify or Framer after you approve each change on an editable approval card. It reads Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4.


For AI search, Sprites'[AI visibility agent](https://www.sprites.ai/ai-visibility) checks how your brand shows up in ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity answers for chosen prompts and writes content aimed at being cited. The side-by-side is on[Sprites vs Ahrefs](https://www.sprites.ai/compare/ahrefs) , and plans are on the[pricing page](https://www.sprites.ai/pricing) , each starting with a 7-day trial for $1.


Before you pick a tier, list how many people need logins and how many competitor reports you run a week. Those two numbers decide your Ahrefs bill more than the plan name does.
